description:
Two readings of the same two observations. Identical evidence sets, mutual contradiction, equal confidence and equal grounding.

The shape the experiment is about: nothing in the evidence separates the readings, because there IS no evidence held by one and not the other. Stage -1 measured what the substrate does to this web unaided - both sides charged 1/3 x 0.7 = 0.2333, both landing at 0.4667, gap exactly zero.

What may be authored here is the topology, the confidences and the evidence sharing. What may NOT be authored is that the pair is underdetermined: there is no field for it in this schema, and `Belief.rivals` is deliberately absent from `BeliefCandidate` and from the extractor schema so that no fixture can declare it. Requirements section 7.

expect.note: Structural properties of the fixture, checkable by reading the file and without running any criterion. They are NOT predictions about what the criterion does - that is the dependent variable and is computed.

evidence.summary: The distant supernovae are dimmer than a static model predicts.
The dimming is the same in every direction we have measured.

beliefs.proposition: The dimming is best explained by a change in expansion over time.
The dimming is best explained by our position within a large underdense region.
